visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright, minimalist living room, two twin-like young women with pigtails in white crop tops and shorts dance in synchronization, smiling brightly with high facial energy. (2) The scene cuts to them in colorful summer outfits—one in purple, one in green—holding straw hats and shopping bags while dancing against a well-lit window background with white curtains. (3) A cut to a bedroom where the girl in purple sits on a bed, looking concerned as a digital silhouette graphic shows skin dullness highlights. (4) Close-up of four Dove product jars on a table with fruit props; a hand reaches for blueberries near a sliced kiwi on a white textured surface. (5) Another close-up focuses on the purple lid of a Dove jar being opened to reveal a creamy, purple-tinted scrub. (6) A hand scoops out the thick, grainy purple texture from the jar, emphasizing its soft consistency. (7) Back to the bedroom, the girl in purple applies the white cream to her knees and legs while sitting on a woven pouf; her skin appears smooth under bright indoor light. (8) Four product jars are arranged on a white towel with a loofah and a monstera leaf background. (9) The girl in purple holds two jars near her face, smiling and glancing at them. (10) Extreme close-ups show the textures of different scrub types being spread across a surface, revealing varying grit sizes. (11) The girl in green applies the scrub to her arm while sitting on a grey couch. (12) A graphic comparison shows two pairs of legs side-by-side, labeled with text indicating a transition from rough to bright skin. (13) The twins dance again in their colorful outfits, now wearing giant cardboard product-jar props around their waists, laughing and moving rhythmically. (14) Final shot shows them standing together holding the actual products, with a text overlay about a promotional offer at POYA.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic pop BGM begins with a strong synth beat. A female narrator speaks with high energy and a bright tone, asking about skin dullness. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. The narrator continues her energetic delivery, introducing the Dove product as the solution. (3) A subtle 'ding' or 'ting' SFX plays during the close-up of fruit. The music beat remains consistent and driving. (4) Multiple 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects punctuate the description of the scrub's texture. The narration remains upbeat and fast-paced. (5) 'Sparkle' and 'magic' sound effects are used as the skin results are demonstrated visually. The music's spectral brightness is high. (6) A final 'pop' and 'whoosh' sequence occurs as the call to action and pricing details are mentioned. The narrator's pitch rises for emphasis at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Dove exfoliating body polish by showcasing its texture, ingredients, and visible skin-brightening results through an energetic dance and lifestyle demonstration.
